_about: Curated corrections and additions to the bundled OpenFlights airline data. Applied to a fresh database by applyCuratedAirlines() (prisma/seed-data/parse.ts) and to an existing one by migration 20261005000100_airline_reference_refresh. IATA = 2-character designator, ICAO = 3-letter; neither is ever inferred from a name.
_sources: OpenFlights airlines.dat (ODbL) - baseline and the existing row state that was audited
Wikipedia 'List of airline codes' (A-Z + 0-9), IATA+ICAO pair must match for every entry
Wikipedia per-airline infobox (IATA/ICAO) for the entries the code list lacked
Logos: images.kiwi.com/airlines/64x64/<IATA>.png, HTTP 200 image verified per code (the app's existing logo CDN)

modes.update: the row already holding this IATA is the same airline (same ICAO): set the canonical name and active flag
modes.relabel: the row holding this IATA is the same company renamed / its successor: relabelled in place, previous identity kept as an inactive record without an IATA code
modes.adopt: the IATA was held by an unrelated (recycled) airline: that row keeps its identity but loses the code; the airline's own existing ICAO-only row gains it
modes.insert: no existing row for this airline: a new one is added (a recycled code is freed from its previous holder first)
